completed_tasks.name: PROD incident: catalog 'Couldn't load products' — root-caused to injectProductSchema selector SyntaxError on quoted SKU-less product name (Muslin Strainer Bags (5" x 15")); fixed via CSS.escape
Error-boundary hardening: injectProductSchema best-effort (try/catch) + loaders 08/16 use .then(onSuccess, onFetchError) so render throws no longer show connection banner

Meta domain-verification meta tag added to <head> of 16 CSP-bearing public pages (incl. index.html)
Deploy workflows: cancel-in-progress true->false (both repos) to prevent stuck Pages deployments
Staging Pages diagnosed (stuck 29acb27 deployment blocked deploys) and unstuck via gh run rerun

human_actions_pending.action: Clear stale/invalid GH_TOKEN env var from shell profile
human_actions_pending.context: It shadows the valid keyring token (which has repo+workflow scopes) and broke gh all session; worked around with `env -u GH_TOKEN`

decisions.decision: Did NOT roll back c86b5b3 (GA4 analytics) for the prod incident
decisions.rationale: Verified c86b5b3 was innocent — its ga4AddToCart calls only run in click handlers, never during render; the real fault was a latent data-dependent selector bug. Rollback would not have fixed it.

decisions.decision: cancel-in-progress: false on deploy workflows (not true)
decisions.rationale: Cancelling mid actions/deploy-pages orphans a Pages deployment in stuck 'in progress' state, blocking all later deploys (froze staging 2026-07-10). Matches GitHub's official Pages workflow guidance.

decisions.decision: Deployed prod-first for the incident (force-push), then staging; later follow-ups staging+prod together
decisions.rationale: Store was down/revenue-facing for the incident; user-directed. Follow-ups were low-risk and verified.
